scope: Tiny paired local contracts;root-owned runtime qualification is separate.

cases.title: Classify defects without dropping source occurrences
cases.input_contract: Add a nullable rejection_reason Column using the declared precedence:missing_id, invalid_id, unknown_status, negative_amount. Keep every source field and row. Unknown amounts are allowed;unknown statuses are not.
cases.expected: Source row 11 has unknown_status, row 12 has missing_id, and the other 10 reasons are NULL. All 12 source_row identities remain.
cases.verification: Assert the exact two(source_row, reason) pairs and the unchanged source count 12.

cases.title: Create the accepted event relation
cases.input_contract: Return source_row, event_id, team, amount_cents, status only for rows with no rejection reason. Preserve the valid void event and all accepted zero/NULL amounts.
cases.expected: Accepted event IDs are 1 through 10, with 10 rows. Event 5 remains accepted as void;IDs 2 and 7 remain accepted with unknown amounts.
cases.verification: Assert the complete accepted ID list, count 10, one void row and two NULL-amount rows.

cases.title: Retain a complete quarantine row
cases.input_contract: Return source_row, event_id, team, amount_cents, status, rejection_reason for rejected records, ordered by source_row when inspected. Keep the original values, including the missing event ID.
cases.expected: Rows are(11,11, A,10, mystery, unknown_status) and (12, NULL, A,5, paid, missing_id). Accepted and quarantined counts sum to 12.
cases.verification: Compare every quarantined field with literal expected rows and check count conservation independently.

cases.title: Publish a NULL-aware paid summary
cases.input_contract: From accepted records, filter paid and group by team into team, rows, valued, total_cents. Count every event, only nonnull amounts, and the exact Long sum. Preserve a NULL team group and a NULL-only amount group.
cases.expected: Groups are A:(3,2,200), B:(2,2,25), C:(1,0, NULL), D:(1,1,200), E:(1,1,0), NULL:(1,1,50). Paid metrics are 9 rows,7 valued,475 cents.
cases.verification: Assert the full typed canonical group list and the global paid metrics against independent literals.

cases.title: Expose projection-plus-distinct loss
cases.input_contract: Return a paid row-level projection retaining event_id, team, amount_cents. Compare it with the deliberately wrong team/amount distinct projection and explain the lost 100-cent event.
cases.expected: The correct projection has metrics(9,7,475);the wrong projection has(8,6,375). IDs 1 and 6 must both remain despite equal team/amount values.
cases.verification: Assert both metric tuples and verify that correct event IDs include 1 and 6 separately.

cases.title: Gate the SQL report on identity and conservation
cases.input_contract: Validate at most 100 unique nonmissing source_row occurrences, unique positive accepted event IDs, and accepted-plus-quarantine conservation before returning a SQL paid summary. Reject a duplicate accepted event ID. Compare SQL output to the same literal groups.
cases.expected: The base 12-row batch passes and matches all six golden groups. Appending source_row13 with a second event_id1 rejects publication instead of choosing a winner.
cases.verification: Assert base SQL parity and a real failure for the duplicate-ID extension;retain the validation failure rather than publishing a partial report.
